canonical_name: No Identification of Legal and Regulatory Requirements
description: Legal, regulatory, and contractual requirements relevant to security are not identified and documented.
applicability: Applies when an organization has not identified, documented, and maintained awareness of applicable legal, statutory, regulatory, and contractual requirements related to information security and the protection of information assets.

metadata.detection_notes: Review compliance register or requirements documentation, verify legal and regulatory monitoring processes, check for contractual obligation tracking, assess requirements communication to relevant personnel, examine compliance assessment and gap analysis processes.
